subject: Interim subprocessor coverage and data-flow attestation request

From: Anna Bauer <anna.bauer@edgewave.com>

Cc: compliance@edgewave.com
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interim subprocessor coverage & data-flow attestation request

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. As we move toward a pilot connection between EdgeWave and Redwood for log forwarding and model telemetry, our compliance team needs a short interim attestation and a provisional subprocessor roster that covers the components that could see EdgeWave data (logs, telemetry, masked PII).

Specifically we need: 
- A provisional list of Redwood subprocessors that process or transmit EdgeWave data (including third-party observability, CDN, and analytics).
- A one-page data-flow sketch that shows where logs traverse (redwood-hosted -> observability -> storage) and any cross-border egress points.
- Any known temporary egress (S3 buckets, staging regions) used during onboarding and their retention policies.

If possible, please attach the provisional roster as an xlsx and the sketch as an SVG or PDF. We are aiming to complete our internal vendor review by EOD Aug 18 and would appreciate a response within 48 hours so we can keep to that schedule.

I have attached our vendor questionnaire for reference. Happy to hop on a short call if it helps.

Best,
Anna Bauer
Head of Compliance
EdgeWave Inc.

Thanks Sean — tagging this as high priority. Quick checklist and what we'll provide: 
1) Provisional subprocessor inventory (spreadsheet) — includes vendor name, role, processing location, and data categories touched. Expected delivery: 48 hours (Aug 17 EOD PDT).
2) Data-flow sketch (SVG) — minimal diagram showing ingress, processing, KV/cache, observability, and storage.
3) Evidence pointers — links to SOC 2 snapshot and KMS/HSM vendor attestation where available. Note: some partners are under NDA and we can provide redacted evidence or a non-public access link on request.

I've attached our vendor_questionnaire_response.pdf with additional contact points. We can provide a redacted SOC summary if required. We do prefer the DocuSign flow for attestations — sending the envelope now.

Anna
